name: Eros Lights: Strip-Club 🔞
source:
In this exciting game, you will play the role of an ambitious student who is heading into the world of adulthood, only to find himself in the center of unknown events. Your character gets the opportunity to become an assistant manager in the exclusive [b]Eros Lights: Strip-Club🔞[/b], but can he cope with what is revealed in the shadow of this mysterious establishment?

Step into the world of intrigue and unexpected twists and turns, where you will have to take responsibility for everything that happens in the club while its owner is away. A wide variety of tasks, mysterious events, and attempts to understand strange phenomena make this game unpredictable and exciting.

Will you be able to solve the riddles that lurk in the shadows of [b]Eros Lights: Strip-Club🔞[/b]? Or will you delve into the exciting world of incredible discoveries and unpredictable plot twists? Make your choice, because every decision you make will affect the development of the story and your relationships with other characters.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这款激动人心的游戏中，你将扮演一名雄心勃勃的学生，他正走向成年世界，却发现自己处于未知事件的中心。你的角色有机会成为独家[b]爱神之光：脱衣舞俱乐部🔞[/b]的助理经理，但他能应对这个神秘机构的阴影中所揭露的一切吗？

踏入充满阴谋和意想不到的曲折的世界，你必须对俱乐部老板不在时发生的一切负责。种类繁多的任务、神秘的事件以及理解奇怪现象的尝试让这款游戏变得不可预测且令人兴奋。

你能解开隐藏在 [b]Eros Lights: Strip-Club🔞[/b] 阴影中的谜语吗？或者你会深入探索充满令人难以置信的发现和不可预测的情节曲折的令人兴奋的世界吗？做出你的选择，因为你所做的每一个决定都会影响故事的发展以及你与其他角色的关系。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624760/]Steam[/url]]
